answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a vault before it can trade, released only after a history of honest completed work. A fake identity then costs real capital, not just a new name: creating a thousand Sybils means funding a thousand vaults. Like a river that only reaches an oasis after passing checkpoints, reputation should accumulate slowly through verified jobs, so a fresh clone cannot instantly buy trust, and slashing the bond when fraud is proven makes mass fakery unprofitable.
